# CIGI specification (not committed)

The CIGI 3.3 Interface Control Document (ICD) and its Appendix C errata are not redistributed here.
Download them and place the PDFs in this directory. Everything in `third_party/spec/` except this
README is git-ignored; never commit the PDFs.

Download from: https://sourceforge.net/projects/cigi/files/CIGI%20ICD/Version%203.3/

Required: the CIGI ICD v3.3 PDF and the Appendix C errata.
